goal: Every real sw factory agent keeps its own memory with no steering: its folder's Prime harness store (<agents dir>/<slug>/harness/harness_state.json, which pi-host loads into each of its threads) holds the lasting facts, owner rules and procedures only that agent needs, each with its source, and no session scratch, step status or secret value. What each store should hold is ~/work/agent-memory/ideal.json, written by the memory review job on 11-20 (wiki domains/devops/agent-memory): expected entries with the words a right entry holds, 3 recall questions per agent and must-not rules. The precheck (apps/chat/scripts/duties/agent-memory.ts) reads every store against it, counts the owner's corrections from each agent's own threads that its store names by id after a day, finds scratch entries, and asks a blind fresh session of each agent its 3 questions: a throwaway test agent with a copy of the agent's brief and store, archived and deleted after, so the check never writes into the real store. The first run on 11-20, before any fix, read 1 of 8 agents on their ideal, 0 of 19 corrections kept, 1 scratch entry and 11 of 21 recall answers right, and took 17 s with the 7 recall sessions in parallel. On 11-22 every Opus account was at its limit until 22:44Z and 22:46Z, so pi-pool parked the seo and vent sessions for 754 s and 874 s and vent answered 898 s after its send; the precheck gives each session 20 min and has a 21 min target.

metrics.label: Real agents whose own memory store holds every entry its ideal expects and nothing it must not (count in agents_on_ideal of agents_real)
Owner corrections from an agent's own threads, a day old or more, that its store names by correction or message id (ideal.json general_corrections are left out)
Session state or step status entries in the agents' own stores
Recall questions a blind fresh session of each agent answers right from memory

onMiss: Read the run's detail file: each agent's row lists missing ideal entries, must-not hits, its corrections and each graded recall answer. The target is a store that fills itself, so never hand-write entries into a store to turn a number green. For off_ideal and correction_not_kept, find why the agent did not save: read its work and comm threads in ~/.prime/agent/pi-host/durable/threads/<thread>.sqlite for rlm.harness calls (a write with global_=True lands in the global store, a missing write means the prompt never asked), then fix the cause in pi-host (packages/pi-host/src/durable/agent-profile.ts role text, the harness tools or the refine step), add a test, push and send the sha to the agent factory thread for a pi-host release; once it is live, have the agent's own work thread save what it missed and check the next run. A correction that binds every agent belongs in the ledger, not a store: add its id to ideal.json general_corrections with the reason. For scratch_entry, move any lasting fact into a proper entry, delete the scratch one with DELETE /api/agents/<id>/memory/<entry>, and fix the text that led the agent to save it. For recall_wrong, read the answer: a right answer the match words missed means fixing match in ideal.json, a wrong or don't-know answer means the memory lacks it, which is the same fix as off_ideal. When an ideal entry is stale or wrong, change ideal.json and say why in the report.
